Interface Result<T>

Type Parameters:
T - type of the successful result
All Known Implementing Classes:
Result.Err, Result.Ok
public interface Result<T>
Functional-style result for secp256k1 -- either Result.Ok or Result.Err. If result is Ok the success result is in Result.Ok.result(), if a failure occurred the error code is in Result.Err.code().

    • checked

      static <T> Result<T> checked(int error_code, Supplier<T> supplier)
      Create a result from an error code and a supplier function. If the error code is 1 (no error), the supplier function is invoked to produce a successful result. Otherwise, an error result is returned containing the error code.
      Type Parameters:
      T - result value type
      Parameters:
      error_code - error code
      supplier - value supplier
      Returns:
      result
